purpose: Expected values and comparison targets for the third fresh live read-only Phase03B post-apply verification, for an external tool to compare its captured output against, or to hand raw captures back for local comparison via compare_captured_results.mjs.

entryValuesFromENTRY_RECEIPT.note: these came from the entry receipt already on file, retained-incident-input/ENTRY_RECEIPT.json -- an external tool does not need to reproduce them, only the post-apply proof must match them

quiescenceAndLedgerGate.quiescenceInvariant: http_queue_count must be 0, http_response_new_since_t0_count must be 0, and pg_net_ttl_seconds must be greater than MAXIMUM_QUIESCENCE_WINDOW_SECONDS (600). http_response_count/http_response_sha256 are DIAGNOSTIC_HISTORY_ONLY -- do not gate on them, they legitimately change as pg_net response history expires under pg_net.ttl.

finalStructure.note: This single query's normalized+hashed output is the ONLY check for final structure AND permissions/RLS AND moderation-definition AND points-definition equivalence in this saga. There is no separate live query for RLS, moderation, or points -- all three are sections inside this one catalog (relations.rls/acl, policies.qual/roles, functions.body/secdef/config/acl covering the moderation and points RPCs). Do not treat 'RLS' or 'moderation' or 'points' as separate PASS/HOLD gates from this one; they share this single artifact and its single hash.

exclusionsRequiredBeforeHashing.kind: exact temporary gate objects (3, not a table exclusion file -- hardcoded)

exclusionsRequiredBeforeHashing.matchRule: EXACT (schema, table) equality only -- no wildcard, no prefix

finalStructure.doNotDo: Do not widen either exclusion. Do not exclude anything not on these two fixed lists. A cardinality mismatch (more or fewer objects removed than 3 and 7 respectively) must FAIL, not silently adjust.

edgeFunctionIdentity.method: Supabase CLI: `supabase functions list --project-ref kldlwszpfkdmsjrjhjym --output-format json`. This is a CLI/API call, not a SQL query -- if the external tool can only run SQL against Postgres, it cannot perform this check and it should be reported NOT_RUN rather than guessed.
edgeFunctionIdentity.hashMethod: sha256 of JSON.stringify of the object with keys sorted alphabetically (see stable()/hashJson() in verify_post_apply.mjs) -- do not hand-roll a different serialization, it will not match

clientCompatibility.reason: Client-compatibility is verified ONLY via a fully local, disposable, socket-only PostgreSQL cluster (scripts/replay-phase03b.mjs runs supabase/tests/phase03b-compatibility.test.sql as pgTAP). It has never been run against production or staging in this saga and should not start now, because pgTAP suites insert/mutate rows inside a test transaction, which is not compatible with a hard no-mutation live constraint. Report CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY as NOT_RUN for the live verification; its confidence comes entirely from the local replay already on file, not from a live check.
clientCompatibility.localOnlyCommand: node scripts/replay-phase03b.mjs --pgtap-sql=supabase/tests/phase03b-compatibility.test.sql   (run on your own machine, never against kldlwszpfkdmsjrjhjym)

targetIdentity.note: Confirm the connected project ref and name match before running anything. Refuse and stop if the tool is pointed at any other project ref, especially cepayqmsoqxshsiyqnvz (staging -- forbidden target for this check).
